column3: MT 3:20. “The sun” is rendered with “the”; NASB renders “calves of the stall” as “calves from the stall” and adds “about.”
MT 3:21. “When I act” is rendered “which I am preparing.”
MT 3:22. “Instruction” is rendered “law,” and “judgments” “ordinances”; NASB adds “even.”
MT 3:24. “Turn back” is rendered “restore,” and “sons” “children”; “total destruction” is rendered “a curse.”
